French 10-year yields surged to 5.142%, while the spread over German Bunds widened to 173 basis points — the widest since 2011.

Budget uncertainty, political instability and violent protests are fueling the selloff.

Meanwhile, investors sought safety in U.S. Treasuries, pushing 10-year yields down 7.3 bps to 5.072%.

European credit stress is also rising, with the iTraxx Crossover index hitting 329 bps, a nearly seven-month high.

Then he explained why that makes AI nothing like the dot-com bubble

"In the internet bubble, we didn't have enough demand because we had to build the internet. People had to get broadband. Originally they had to get their browser at Fry's. There weren't enough consumers on the internet to absorb all the bandwidth that had gotten built out."

"The lack of demand killed it. We don't really have a lack of demand in AI, so I think the dynamics will be different."

ON THIS DAY IN 1879, THOMAS EDISON CREATED THE FIRST PRACTICAL, LONG-LASTING LIGHT BULB

For months, his bulbs had burned out after just a few hours. His platinum filament kept melting.

The fix came while he was idly rolling a piece of carbon between his fingers. It gave him an idea: turn other materials into carbon and use them as the filament.

He tried a carbonized cotton thread inside a glass vacuum bulb, and it gave off a soft orange glow.

It burned for about 15 hours.

OVER 75% OF NEW TESLA $TSLA BUYERS IN NORTH AMERICA ARE NOW TAKING FSD (SUPERVISED)

That's up nearly 20 percentage points from last quarter.

Active FSD subscriptions hit 1.74 million, up 67% from a year ago. FSD is now approved in 9 EU countries, where more than 100,000 customers have already driven over 160 million kilometers with it.

posts.text:
TESLA $TSLA ROBOTAXI MILES GREW 8X IN ONE QUARTER

Tesla started giving Robotaxi rides in Cybercabs in Austin on September 3, and the service is now running from 6am to midnight.

It reached nearly 2 million cumulative unsupervised miles by the end of the quarter. Riders can even use Grok inside the Cybercab to manage their inbox, calendar and tasks by voice.

posts.text:
THE TESLA $TSLA SEMI IS NOW IN VOLUME PRODUCTION

The top version can go 500 miles fully loaded at 82,000 lbs, at an efficiency of 1.7 kWh per mile.

That means it uses about a third of the energy of a comparable diesel truck to haul the same load. In trucking, energy is one of the biggest costs per mile, so Tesla says that gives Semi operators a real advantage.

The Nevada factory is built for 25,000 Semis a year, and Tesla deployed its first pre-assembled Megacharger to support the ramp.

posts.text:
TESLA $TSLA HAS NOW TOPPED $100 BILLION IN TRAILING 12-MONTH REVENUE FOR THE SECOND STRAIGHT QUARTER

And its margins are moving higher too

Gross margin climbed to 19.6% in Q3, up from 16.8% last quarter and 18.0% a year ago.

Its services and other business also posted a record $734 million in gross profit, with revenue up 33% from a year ago thanks to charging, insurance and parts sales.

U.S. AND ISRAEL REPORTEDLY PLAN NEW IRAN STRIKES AFTER MIDTERMS

The U.S. and Israel have reportedly developed plans for renewed attacks on Iran after the November 3 elections, according to the New York Times.

Potential targets include energy infrastructure, nuclear facilities and missile assets.

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth reportedly discussed the plans with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
